verdict.rationale: LobeChat's official self-hosting docs include a dedicated 'Deploying LobeHub with Docker Compose' guide under a self-hosting/platform section, so the Docker Compose path is covered. The pack shows no official guides for the other targets in the story. Missing for 10: Kubernetes/Helm deployment guide, small-VPS deployment guide, Raspberry Pi/ARM deployment guide, evidence the guides are maintained, independent or hands-on corroboration of the install paths.
